subject.title: Feature Request: Memory Trust Tagging by Source

question: Should OpenClaw define a portable framework-owned memory provenance and influence-policy contract, or leave trust-governed memory entirely to external plugins and MCP integrations?
rationale: The choice determines security ownership, plugin SDK compatibility, persisted schema and migration requirements, default behavior, and which runtime or UI surfaces must enforce review decisions.

options.title: Define portable core contract
options.body: Specify framework-authenticated provenance and influence metadata in the memory SDK, with backend implementations and policy defaults developed through a security-reviewed design.

options.title: Plugin-only capability
options.body: Keep default memory unchanged and document vetted memory plugins or MCP integrations as the supported path for trust-governed storage and retrieval.

options.title: Guidance only
options.body: Retain the current Markdown authority guidance without adding machine-enforced trust metadata or policy.

recommendation.title: Define portable core contract
recommendation.body: Specify framework-authenticated provenance and influence metadata in the memory SDK, with backend implementations and policy defaults developed through a security-reviewed design.

likelyOwner.reason: This person supplied the prior detailed review and has the strongest available history signal on the central memory contracts.
